requires: Root review of the 93-DOF semantic adapter and separate explicit authorization before any numerical K/force case.

primary_global_layout.formula: 27 SOURCE_BASE scalar shapes plus four GLOBAL_FRONT scalar shapes, each times ux/uy/uz

separate_per_source_diagnostic_layout.formula: 27 sources times BASE plus four source-owned branch terms, each times ux/uy/uz

predeclared_tolerances.direct_analytic_and_B_checks: 3e-11 * max(scale, abs(a), abs(b)); gradient scale is 1/R in 1/m
predeclared_tolerances.candidate_mode_null_action: 2e-11 times max absolute row-sum bound for K times the candidate vector
predeclared_tolerances.threshold_policy: No threshold adjustment after viewing any later authorized result.

planned_checks: independently reconstruct all engineering six-Voigt B columns from displacement-gradient tensors
verify exact affine plus four-global-branch representation using a synthetic linearly reproducing tetrahedral base row
verify 27-source counts and unique scope-tagged IDs: 93 global-front and 405 diagnostic
verify paired source permutation preserves semantic IDs and the raw 24-DOF K bytes
rebuild the complete 4-source 24x24 primary K entry-by-entry from direct tensor B and an independent Lamé C formula; require relative maximum error <= 3e-11
report raw unsymmetrized K maximum asymmetry and relative asymmetry, plus physical and diagnostic candidate null residual ratios
report assembled dimensions 24 and 60; for 27 sources check unique IDs only, with no 93-DOF matrix or spectrum
check the six physical rigid candidate vectors annihilate the synthetic 24-DOF raw K
check the six per-source branch-dependency candidates on the separate 405-layout diagnostic K
compare isotropic C and one raw surface force against independent formulas; check immutable byte outputs
verify ambiguous cut, nonfinite weight, and semantic ID mismatch fail closed
not_included: No MLS, actual field/provider, actual geometry/quadrature, solver, KKT, eigenspectrum, fracture, or material calibration run. The checker assembles only 24- and 60-DOF synthetic matrices; 27-source coverage is semantic-ID inventory only.

The planned null-vector action checks do not count the spectrum. Mechanical eligibility still requires a separately authorized actual 93-DOF spectrum confirming six physical zero modes and no unexplained nulls.
No rank truncation, ridge, pseudoinverse, load projection, or symmetrization.
